parameters.name: AddClientGeolocationHeader
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to add a header that contains visitor geolocation information. Valid values:

- `on`: Add the header.

- `off`: Do not add the header.

parameters.name: AddRealClientIpHeader
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to add the `ali-real-client-ip` header, which contains the real client IP. Valid values:

- `on`: Add the header.

- `off`: Do not add the header.

parameters.name: RealClientIpHeaderName
parameters.description: The name of the header that contains the real client IP. The name must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits (0-9), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version of the site. For sites with version management enabled, this parameter specifies the version to which the configuration applies. Default value: 0.
